verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a consumer graphics card, and issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent is a credential-management capability outside the product type of GPU hardware. Nothing in the evidence shows the card ships any credential or token-issuance capability: the docs cover DLSS, Reflex, CUDA tooling and local AI acceleration, and the probes found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
